label: Shopping sites
description: Where Dayspring can look things up for you to buy (Settings → Shopping). It reads the store in its own browser window, where you signed in yourself. It never places an order: adding to the cart needs your yes, and checkout is always yours to press.

capabilities: price, brand, rating, Prime and sort filters
checkout page for you to review
Subscribe & Save: list, notices, skip a delivery (with your yes)
entries.notes: Read in Dayspring's own browser window (the same one YouTube and Spotify sign in to), at a calm pace, a few pages at a time. Robot checks are shown to you, never answered. The shopping test script checks it against a stand-in Amazon on the same computer; Amazon changes its pages now and then, so if something stops showing, update Dayspring.
howToSetUp: Open Settings → Shopping and turn on Shopping on Amazon.
Press Sign in to Amazon. Amazon's sign-in opens in Dayspring's browser window: sign in there yourself (with your 2-step code if you use one). Dayspring notices when you're done.
Say “find a waterproof work boot size 11 under $120 on Amazon”, or press 🛒 Shop by the clock.

entries.model: Other Amazon stores (amazon.ca, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de and the rest)
entries.notes: Only the United States store for now.
entries.reason: Each Amazon store has its own pages, filters, prices and sign-in. Dayspring is built and tested for amazon.com only so far.
